openQuestions.text: What is orca's session-card content model (title, last-message preview, identity, progress, cwd/branch) versus our SessionCardDto (id, status, updatedAt, messageCount)?
What composer/input patterns (attachments, paste-image, voice/dictation, @-mentions, slash/command-arg UI, prompt history) can we copy as interaction chrome versus host-backed capabilities?
How does orca list, group, sort, filter, and badge parallel sessions on mobile home / agent-history, and which of those are drop-in view affordances versus new host fields?

What message-level chat interactions exist (context menu, copy-code, reply/quote, edit-and-resend, regenerate/retry, in-conversation search, per-turn nav) and which logic is portable under fail-closed?
How do streaming/progress, peek/preview, and session→chat navigation (resume marker, tabs, back-swipe, single-flight open) map onto view affordances versus new host fields?
What is orca's session-card content model (title, last-message preview, identity, progress, cwd/branch) versus our `SessionCardDto` (`id`, `status`, `updatedAt`, `messageCount`)?

keyFindings.text: F-ITER001-CARD Session card is a derived view over a host-owned AiVaultSession
groups with `groupAiVaultSessions(filtered, 'folder')` using last-two path segments as the section label
empty-scope-path fallback: do **not** flash an empty list; show unnarrowed until worktrees resolve
F-ITER001-PEEK Expand-in-place peek of 5 turns is an interaction over host previews
F-ITER001-RESUME Resume is a nested single-flight action, not a client pin
F-ITER001-PTR Pull-to-refresh is a view affordance over a host refetch
F-ITER001-EMPTY Hide-empty keeps recoverable zero-turn sessions
`id`, `agent`, `agentLabel`
`title` (`session.title || 'Untitled session'`)
`lastMessage` (latest user/assistant preview turn)
`messageCount`, `timeAgo`
`isCurrentWorktree` (cwd path-prefix vs active worktree)
F-ITER001-GROUP Home list groups by folder and sorts by updated
query + agent set + `sort: 'updated'` + `hideEmptySessions: true`
scoped tabs (`workspace` / `project` / `all`) **narrow by cwd path-prefix on the client** because the host treats `scopePaths` as a widening union
F-ITER010-FILES @-mentions debounce a host path search; older hosts fall back to one full `files.list`
F-ITER010-ASK AskUserQuestion is a stepped wizard; answers are option **indices**, not pasted labels
F-ITER010-STACK Prompt stack: structured Ask > heuristic permission > heuristic question
F-ITER011-HEURISTIC Permission cards are often parsed from last-assistant TUI text, not a structured ticket
F-ITER011-STATUS Structured `{ approval: { tool, summary } }` on `interactivePrompt` is the reliable host signal
F-ITER011-PAUSE Never answer a working agent
F-ITER012-HIST Electron keeps a **client-local** stack of sent strings; ArrowUp on empty draft recalls
F-ITER012-MOBILE Mobile native-chat has no history stack
F-ITER012-DELTA Other desktop-only composer pieces: `$` skills picker, paste handler, interrupt-on-Escape
F-ITER013-MSG Native-chat copy is **whole-message prose**, not per-fence
F-ITER013-FENCE Per-fence Copy lives on the **editor** `CodeBlockCopyButton`, not native-chat
F-ITER013-MD Mobile `MobileMarkdown` has path taps and mermaid, no copy-fence
F-ITER014-SLASH Rename/archive/new/fork/delete are **agent CLI strings** in the Codex catalog
F-ITER014-UI No in-chat overflow menu for those verbs on mobile or Electron native-chat
F-ITER014-NEW Home "New Workspace" is not New Chat; Codex `/new` exits/starts a TUI chat
F-ITER015-SCREEN History is a four-kind machine: loading | error | capability-missing | ready
F-ITER015-CHAT Empty/loading/error copy is shared desktop/mobile
F-ITER015-STALE Active dots decay to idle after 30 minutes without host updates
F-ITER015-TIME `formatTimeAgo` is a pure function of `(ts, now)`; history list does not tick
F-ITER016-SLASH Option rows dispatch **agent TUI commands**, not a host session-options API
F-ITER016-REPORT Hook-reported model is authority; identical re-reports must not revert a user pick
F-ITER016-FLIP Flip-only mid-session options refuse to apply without a known baseline
F-ITER016-SCOPE Per-tab option records (cap 32) survive chat↔terminal remount
F-ITER017-HAPTIC Five named helpers; Android avoids VIBRATE permission
F-ITER017-SWIPE History cards have no swipe actions, multi-select, or long-press menu
F-ITER017-PTR Pull-to-refresh is the only list gesture besides tap
F-ITER018-MIN Minimum home-list bundle (does not require paths)
`hasMore` / transcript page token — only if we stop sending full snapshots.
F-ITER018-CHAT Chat RPCs distinct from the card DTO
F-ITER018-RULE Opaque identifiers remain for `id`; titles are not ids
`title` — string, host may send `"Untitled session"`
`lastMessagePreview` — short redacted string (or `previewMessages[]` capped)
`agent` — label the host already knows (model optional)
`attention` — `none | blocked | waiting | completed` (iter 3: unread ≠ working)
F-ITER018-OPT Optional fields (product decision, not required for ranked chat UX)

`cwd` / `projectLabel` / `branch` — orca History uses these for Workspace/Project tabs. Our home copy currently **forbids paths**. A **redacted project label** (not a filesystem path) would unlock grouping without leaking machine paths.
`pinned` + pin RPC — orca pins **worktrees** (`worktree.set`), not AiVault sessions. A Pi pin would be a **new** host mutation, not an orca copy.
`previewMessages[]` — enables peek-before-open (iter 1). Heavier than one preview string.
F-ITER019-JOIN Home unread can be a **view join** of host Inbox tickets onto session ids
sources: Prior iterations 1–3 (Electron unread, History vs Home)

keyFindings.text: F-ITER002-RESUME Home Resume is a last-visited worktree slot, inert until the host is connected
F-ITER002-NEW New Workspace is not a new chat session
F-ITER002-ROW Worktree row is a workspace object, not a chat-session card
F-ITER002-PIN Pin is host-backed with a local overlay; device-only pins are not the orca pattern
F-ITER002-SORT Sections: Pinned overlay, hide-sleeping, PR groups, attention sort
F-ITER002-AGENT Nested agent rows: state dot, last message, unvisited bold, 30-min stale decay
F-ITER020-CHAT Chat-gap audit
F-ITER020-HOME Home-gap audit
F-ITER020-OPEN Still operator/host questions (not missing orca files)
Confirm Inbox item includes `sessionId` (iter 19 inferred).
Whether product lifts path ban for a redacted `projectLabel`.
Whether paste-image / file-search RPCs already exist on Pi relay (out of orca scope).
F-ITER003-UNREAD Unread is done/blocked/waiting, never working, and sessionBoundary done is excluded
F-ITER003-DOT Live attention dots omit resting done
F-ITER003-TITLE Titles prefer conversation name / orchestration label / task preview, never dispatch preamble
F-ITER003-COMPACT Compact rows stopPropagation so nested activate ≠ open worktree
F-ITER003-META Electron history metadata: msgs, subagents, Not saved, live tick, model
F-ITER004-MATRIX Four objects, one DTO
F-ITER004-SEARCH Search operators are host-field consumers, not a client index
F-ITER004-FALSE Worktree and paneKey objects are false drop-ins onto Pi session cards
F-ITER005-COPY Agent messages get copy + scroll-to-top; copy tints the bubble 700ms
F-ITER005-TOOLS Tool calls fold into expandable runs, not boxed evidence groups
F-ITER005-ABSENT No regenerate, reply/quote, edit-and-resend, long-press menu, or in-chat search in native-chat
F-ITER005-PINCH Font scale / pinch-to-zoom is a view affordance
F-ITER005-ROLES User bubble inverted; reasoning styled separately; agent is default
F-ITER006-SEND Send is single-flight; draft is not trimmed on the wire by the composer; image-only is a valid send
F-ITER006-AT Slash is line-leading only; @file is a whitespace-bounded mention that asks the host for paths
F-ITER006-IMG Image attach + clipboard paste is a host upload lease, not a data-URL in the DTO
F-ITER006-MIC Dictation is a paired-desktop speech RPC with setup-required fail-closed
F-ITER006-OPTIONS Session-option pickers sit in the composer action row
F-ITER007-STREAM Streaming is a synthetic bubble gated against transcript catch-up, throttled 50ms
F-ITER007-PENDING Optimistic user echo includes image preview URIs until the transcript replaces it
F-ITER007-WORK Working bar is presentation-only; Stop is a host interrupt
F-ITER007-LOCK Input lock reasons are disconnected vs waiting (lease), never revoke editable
F-ITER007-DRAFT Composer text is owned by the route so dictation can write it; drafts keyed by chat scope
F-ITER008-TABS Scope tabs are a client view over host sessions, with empty-path fallback already documented
F-ITER008-SEARCH Search box is local filter with operator hint in the placeholder
F-ITER008-NOTICE Skipped-transcript banner is host scan honesty, not a client hide
F-ITER008-HAPTIC Resume fail/success uses dedicated haptic helpers; disconnected resume is error haptic + "Waiting for host..."
F-ITER009-LIVE Live-edge follow is `atBottom` gated; jump-to-latest is a FAB only when scrolled up
F-ITER009-PAGE Load-earlier fires near the top (`contentOffset.y < 60`) and as an explicit header button
F-ITER009-VIEW Chat vs terminal is a **device** preference overlay, fail-closed if the override store is unreadable
F-ITER009-LOCK 600ms settle on lock edges so a dead PTY cannot flash the composer enabled
F-ITER009-A11Y Send failure is the only error channel and is `accessibilityLiveRegion="assertive"`
